data.name: Gilgamesh Drift
data.detailed_description:
Gilgamesh Drift is a psychedelic rhythm-parkour game set onboard a colossal space station, anchored in the orbit of a supermassive black hole.

Parkour your way through the ruins of Brinkharbor, a once utopian society where death itself held no sway, now fallen into desolation; slowly crumbling to a mysterious force of fractal corruption. 

Follow the Wanderer and their faithful companion Birdy through the 5 districts of this city-station, each with their own unique visual identity and gameplay challenges. Ascend the megastructure and aid the mechanical caretakers that are its only remaining (friendly) inhabitants. Piece together the mystery and uncover the story of Brinkharbor in this modern sci-fi take on the Epic of Gilgamesh. 

Features:

  • A Prince of Persia inspired parkour system where you leap, slide, mantle, dash and wallrun through the crumbling ruins of a megastructure.

  • Rhythm-based gameplay where every parkour move is synced to the beat.

  • A high-octane Mystical Phonk soundtrack by the composer of Gloomwood, Taylor Shechet. 

  • 6 different areas that each have 3 levels, for a total of 18 levels.

  • Unique music tailored to the vibes of each level. 

  • A cast of fun and melancholic characters that you can't help but relate to, as they try their best to eke out a life in the ruins of this once mighty civilization. 

  • An enigmatic world where EVERYTHING pulses to the beat.

  • A synesthetic art style incorporating fractal art from the depths of the demoscene, merging with the music into a trip you'll never forget.

data.short_description: Gilgamesh Drift is a psychedelic rhythm-parkour game. Dash, leap, and vault to the beat to escape the ruins of a colossal space station and teach a godlike AI how to love and let go.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 1909 or higher)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD FX 8350 or equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 970 / AMD Radeon R9 290 or equivalent with 4GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD recommended for optimal loading times. Stable 60 FPS at 1080p on Low settings.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit (latest version)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: 16 GB RAM
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 15 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: SSD strongly recommended. Targets 60+ FPS at 1080p on High settings with full fractal effects. 144Hz display recommended for rhythm gameplay synchronization.
